definition: A supplemental schedule used to report income or loss from rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations, estates, trusts, and residual interests in REMICs.

includes.text: Reports income and loss from rental real estate and royalties
includes.quote: Income or Loss From Rental Real Estate and Royalties

includes.text: Reports income and loss from partnerships and S corporations
includes.quote: Income or Loss From Partnerships and S Corporations

includes.text: Reports income and loss from estates and trusts
includes.quote: Income or Loss From Estates and Trusts

excludes.text: Does not report self-employed business income of sole proprietor
Does not report farming income and expenses
Does not report employee business expenses

discriminators.text: Reports income allocated among multiple partners or entities receiving separate statements of their share, whereas the sibling reports business income of a single self-employed individual
discriminators.quote: Income or Loss From Partnerships and S Corporations

discriminators.text: Reports rental real estate and royalty income; the sibling is specifically for farming operations
discriminators.quote: Income or Loss From Rental Real Estate and Royalties

discriminators.text: Reports income from passive rental and investment activities; the sibling reports employee business expenses and reimbursements
